The '''Corellian Trade Summit''' was a major summit held in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]]. Attended by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], it was disrupted by the [[Sacorrian Triad]]'s [[Corellian Crisis|Starbuster Plot]].<ref name="Ambush" />
